title: Binding of Isaac developer removes AI music from Repentance Plus
slides: Why did Binding of Isaac's dev pull its new music?
Repentance Plus shipped with an AI-generated soundtrack
The composer credit was quietly missing at launch
Players who bought the DLC got tracks nobody stands behind
Check what you're paying for before the next patch drops
thread_text:
1. AI tracks in Isaac DLC

Repentance Plus shipped with an AI-generated soundtrack, and players who bought the DLC got music no one stands behind.

2. Composer credit vanished

At launch, the composer credit was quietly missing — no public explanation, no name attached to the new tracks.

3. Dev pulled the music

Binding of Isaac's developer removed the AI soundtrack after backlash, leaving buyers with tracks that may never return.

4. You paid for what?

DLC buyers got AI-generated music that wasn't disclosed upfront — and now the tracks are gone.

5. Check before you buy

Before the next patch drops, check what's actually in the DLC. Does the store page list a composer? Start there.

You bought the Repentance Plus DLC and got a soundtrack nobody will put their name on.

The Binding of Isaac developer shipped the expansion with AI-generated music. 🎮

At launch, the composer credit was quietly missing — no name, no explanation.

After backlash, the dev pulled the tracks entirely, leaving buyers with music that may never come back.

If you publish or sell content, check the credits before you pay: does the store page list a composer? Start there. 🔍
